scripts.title: [Beta] ScriptBlox ingame UI
scripts.features:
Beta Release, some things might be buggy.

There is an experimental fastmode, you can enable it by executing this:

getgenv().fastmode = true

The script will save a file with some information about each script that has ever been loaded locally to make it faster and not break as often due to rate limiting but this also prevents to grab new information if the script's description changed for example, to fix that, use the "Clear Cache" button on top.

Latest Update:
 + Comments
 + Better Caching for profile pictures
 * Changed location for caches (It will delete all other cache once and create the new files in the correct locations, only happens when the cache file is in the wrong location)

Latest Minor Change:
 * Removed background from Images making them look much cleaner no matter their aspect ratio

Current Features:
 - Search
 - Execute
 - Info:
     - Execute
     - Copy ScriptBlox Link
     - Copy Script

function createfolders(path)
	local pathtbl = string.split(path, "/")
	for i, v in pairs(pathtbl) do
		if i == 1 then
			if not isfolder(v) then
				makefolder(v)
			end
		else
			local newpath = pathtbl[1]
			for i2=2, i-1 do
				newpath = newpath.. "/" ..pathtbl[i2]
			end
			newpath = newpath.. "/" ..v
			if not isfolder(newpath) then
				makefolder(newpath)
			end
		end
	end
end

function fixScript(scriptObj)
	if not scriptObj["script"] or not scriptObj["owner"] or not scriptObj["features"] then
		local cacheObj = cache[scriptObj["_id"]]
		if cacheObj then
			scriptObj["script"] = _if(scriptObj["script"], scriptObj["script"], cacheObj.script)
			scriptObj["features"] = _if(scriptObj["features"], scriptObj["features"], cacheObj.features)
			scriptObj["owner"] = _if(scriptObj["owner"], scriptObj["owner"], cacheObj.owner)
		else
			local req = HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGetAsync("https://www.scriptblox.com/api/script/".. scriptObj.slug)).script
			scriptObj["script"] = _if(scriptObj["script"], scriptObj["script"], req.script)
			scriptObj["features"] = _if(scriptObj["features"], scriptObj["features"], req.features)
			scriptObj["owner"] = _if(scriptObj["owner"], scriptObj["owner"], req.owner)
			
			cache[scriptObj["_id"]] = req
		end
	end
	return scriptObj
end
